newsitem.title: USA: Ohio bill would package vote on school bonds, tax.
newsitem.headline: Ohio bill would package vote on school bonds, tax.

text.p: A bill that would allow Ohio school districts to package tax and bond questions together on the ballot has been introduced in the Ohio Senate.

The bill, introduced by State Sen. Scott Nein, R-Middletown, would let districts combine in one ballot measure proposed property tax levies for capital projects and operating expenses, bond issues, and income taxes.

Currently school districts must submit separate ballot questions for each, according to Warren Russell, director of legislative services for the Ohio Association of School Boards, which is supporting the bill.
"In some situations, (schools) have ended up with voter approval for a building, but they couldn't open it because they had no money to operate it," he explained.
